checked_claim: Stryker defines detected as killed + timeout; undetected as survived + no coverage; valid as detected + undetected; mutation score as detected / valid * 100; covered as detected + survived; covered-code score as detected / covered * 100. Timeout counts as detected but remains its own state. Runtime errors, compile errors, ignored, and pending do not enter valid.
